simple.meaning: רָוֶה (râveh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sated (with drink).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 29:18. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָוֶה (H7302).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רָוֶה (râveh) / H7302 is traced through Deuteronomy 29:18, Isaiah 58:11, Jeremiah 31:12 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7302. raveh רָוֶה adjective watered ; — masculine singular ׳ר , of garden גַּן (in simile) Jer 31:12 ; Isa 58:11 ; feminine singular הָרָוָה Deut 29:18 (opposed to הַצְּמֵאָה ; apparently of herbage, in proverb, expression for everything ); perhaps also construct רְוֵה Job 10:15 = sated with afflication (for רְאֵה ), see [ רָאֶה ].
